description: Vera finishing brand package — same finishing/assembly engine as FSC/PureMed (content-finish.js + content-reel.js) pointed at Vera's navy/bone/gold theme. Grades are soft and warm to suit calm clinic footage; the reel transition dips to white, not black. Reels are OPTIONAL for the POC (static + carousel run by default); this exists so the option works. Canon for the engine: fightstar-championship/fsc-clip-finishing-plan.md.

logoBug.note: Bone leaf mark (light raster), bottom-right — reads over the soft/warm clinic grades. ffmpeg has no SVG decoder, so the overlay uses the PNG (assets/vera-mark.svg is the editable source; assets/vera-mark.png is the navy variant).

colorGrades.note: Soft clinical lift — airy, slightly desaturated. Calm, light-filled room.
Gentle warm cast to sit with the bone/gold palette without going clinical-cyan.

stings.note: Mark + handle CTA closer. Soft, no urgency.

transitions.note: Dip to white — the airy clinic take, not FSC's dip-black.

overlaySet.note: Navy bar (theme primary), Fraunces display. Text from the clip's overlay.strap / finish.lowerThird.
